description:
[Trading Data API] Current spot price for crypto (Coinbase) or US equities/ETFs (Alpaca SIP), via the shared routing layer.

**Example:** `/v1/price?symbol=BTC`

Use when you need the current spot price of one crypto asset or US stock/ETF. Not for history or candles (use ohlcv), or a trading view (use momentum_score or verdict).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

class.description: Optional. stock|crypto — required for symbols outside the curated list.

symbol.description: Required. e.g. BTC, ETH, SUI, NVDA, SPY.

name: price
